welcome.title: Let Agents Connect Securely
welcome.lede:
Let Grok Bot and Muse in the cloud use Claude Code and Codex on your computer,
and give specialist tasks to specialist agents.
welcome.promise: Tasks are end-to-end encrypted, so the server never sees your content.

authorize.title: What Does This Computer Do in Aide?
authorize.body: Aide only does what’s listed below. It never changes system settings or reads your files.
authorize.deviceBody: See and manage all your machines, agents and tasks here.
authorize.deviceOff: Off: this computer is a machine only. It runs tasks and can’t see your other machines. Ideal for a work computer.
authorize.shareBody: Aide runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins. When turned off, you can still use your other machines and turn this on later in Settings.

password.title: Log In to Your Aide
password.body: Your server, account and password. Once logged in, this computer is one of your devices: no other device approves it, and there is no code to compare.

setUp.title: Set Up a New Server
setUp.body: Enter the address of the Aide server you deployed, the setup code it showed when it first started, and the account and password it will keep. Every device, machine and agent then logs in with them.
setUp.plain: Not encrypted (HTTP). Tasks stay end-to-end encrypted, but the setup code, your password as you log in and which machines are online travel in plain text for anyone on the network to read, and Claude and ChatGPT won’t connect. Try it on a trusted network only; for ongoing use, give the server a domain with HTTPS.
